input: Research noise-canceling headphones within my budget

gold.taskDescription: Research and identify the best noise-canceling headphones that fit the user's budget and specific needs.

questions.title: What is your exact budget in your local currency?
questions.description: Determine the maximum amount the user is willing to spend.

questions.title: Are you looking for over-ear, on-ear, or in-ear headphones?
questions.description: Identify the preferred headphone form factor.

questions.title: What is the primary environment you will use these in?
questions.description: Understand the main use case setting such as office, commute, gym, or travel.

questions.title: Do you need wired, wireless, or either connection type?
questions.description: Clarify the connectivity preference for the headphones.

questions.title: Which brands or models have you already considered or ruled out?
questions.description: Identify any prior research or brand preferences the user has.

questions.title: How important is microphone quality for calls or voice use?
questions.description: Determine whether call or voice functionality is a deciding factor.

questions.title: What is your single most important feature beyond noise canceling?
questions.description: Identify the top priority feature such as battery life, sound quality, comfort, or portability.
